notablePrerequisites: Myr Welder does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Myr Welder using Empowered Autogenerator's ability by tapping it, putting a charge counter on Myr Welder and adding {R} or {W} for each charge counter on Myr Welder.
Activate Myr Welder using Duergar Mine-Captain's ability by paying {1}{R/W} and untapping it, giving attacking creatures +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat.
